title: Discrete Quantization on Spherical Geometries: Explicit Models, Computations, and Didactic Exposition
summary: We present an analytically explicit study of optimal discrete quantization on spherical geometries equipped with the geodesic metric, focusing on highly symmetric configurations on the unit sphere $\mathbb S^2$. Three discrete uniform models are analyzed and closed-form expressions for optimal quantizers and mean-square errors are derived. (I) For $N$ equally spaced points on the equator, exact error formulas are obtained for both divisible and non-divisible cases, showing that optimal Voronoi cells form contiguous arcs with midpoint representatives.
